import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
#0:
avocado_clean = pd.read_csv("avocado-updated-2020.csv")
#1:
#This dataset contains weekly avocado retail scan data by: date, geography, avocado type (conventional/organic), and year. It also has average price and total sales volume. Lastly, it has sales volume by PLU code and bag size.
#2:
avocado_clean["date"] = pd.to_datetime(avocado_clean["date"])
avocado_clean = avocado_clean.rename(
    columns={
        "4046": "small_hass_volume",
        "4225": "large_hass_volume",
        "4770": "extra_large_hass_volume",
        "total_bags": "bag_volume",
        "small_bags": "small_bag_volume",
        "large_bags": "large_bag_volume",
        "xlarge_bags": "extra_large_bag_volume",
    }
)
major_regions = {
    "Great Lakes", "Midsouth", "Northeast", "Plains",
    "South Central", "Southeast", "West"
}

statewide_regions = {
    "California", "South Carolina"
}

national_region = {"Total U.S."}
avocado_clean["geography_type"] = np.select(
    [
        avocado_clean["geography"].eq("Total U.S."),
        avocado_clean["geography"].isin(major_regions),
        avocado_clean["geography"].isin(statewide_regions),
    ],
    [
        "national_total",
        "major_region",
        "statewide_region",
    ],
    default="metro_market"
)
print("\nMissing values:")
print(avocado_clean.isna().sum())

print(f"\nDuplicate rows: {avocado_clean.duplicated().sum()}")
metro_avocados = avocado_clean.query("geography_type == 'metro_market'").copy()
summary_avocados = avocado_clean.query(
    "geography_type != 'metro_market'"
).copy()
print("\nGeography categories:")
print(avocado_clean["geography_type"].value_counts())
print("\nCleaned metro-market data:")
print(metro_avocados.head())

#3:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

major_regions = [
    "Great Lakes", "Midsouth", "Northeast", "Plains",
    "South Central", "Southeast", "West"
]

organic_small_hass_2017 = (
    avocado_clean[
        (avocado_clean["year"] == 2017)
        & (avocado_clean["type"] == "organic")
        & (avocado_clean["geography"].isin(major_regions))
    ]
    .groupby("geography", as_index=False)["small_hass_volume"]
    .sum()
    .sort_values("small_hass_volume", ascending=False)
)

print(organic_small_hass_2017.head(1))
# The West sold the most total organic Haas avocados.
  geography  small_hass_volume
6      West         1870206.29
#4:
avocado_clean["month"] = avocado_clean["date"].dt.month
avocado_clean["day"] = avocado_clean["date"].dt.day
avocado_clean["year_from_date"] = avocado_clean["date"].dt.year

monthly_average_volume = (
    avocado_clean.groupby("month", as_index=False)["total_volume"]
    .mean()
    .sort_values("total_volume", ascending=False)
)

print(monthly_average_volume.head(1))
# May had the highest average volume of avocado sales.
   month  total_volume
4      5  1.123632e+06
#5:
import seaborn as sns
non_metro_geographies = [
    "Total U.S.",
    "California",
    "South Carolina",
    "Great Lakes",
    "Midsouth",
    "Northeast",
    "Plains",
    "South Central",
    "Southeast",
    "West",
]

metro_avocados = avocado_clean[
    ~avocado_clean["geography"].isin(non_metro_geographies)
].copy()

top_five_metros = (
    metro_avocados.groupby("geography")["total_volume"]
    .mean()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(5)
    .index
)

top_five_metro_data = metro_avocados[
    metro_avocados["geography"].isin(top_five_metros)
]

print(top_five_metros.tolist())
plt.figure(figsize=(13, 7))

sns.boxplot(
    data=top_five_metro_data,
    x="geography",
    y="total_volume",
    order=top_five_metros,
    hue="geography",
    legend=False
)

plt.title("Total Avocado Volume: Five Metro Areas With Highest Average Sales")
plt.xlabel("Metro Area")
plt.ylabel("Total Volume")
plt.xticks(rotation=25, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
['Los Angeles', 'New York', 'Dallas/Ft. Worth', 'Houston', 'Phoenix/Tucson']

#7:
price_summary = (
    california_avocados
    .groupby(["geography", "type"])["average_price"]
    .agg(["mean", "median", "std", "min", "max"])
    .round(2)
)

print(price_summary)
price_comparison = (
    california_avocados
    .pivot(
        index=["date", "geography"],
        columns="type",
        values="average_price"
    )
    .reset_index()
)
price_comparison["price_difference"] = (
    price_comparison["organic"] - price_comparison["conventional"]
)
average_price_gap = (
    price_comparison
    .groupby("geography", as_index=False)["price_difference"]
    .mean()
    .sort_values("price_difference", ascending=False)
)

print(average_price_gap)
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

sns.boxplot(
    data=california_avocados,
    x="geography",
    y="average_price",
    hue="type",
    order=california_regions
)

plt.title("Organic vs. Conventional Avocado Prices in California Metro Areas")
plt.xlabel("California Metro Region")
plt.ylabel("Average Price ($)")
plt.legend(title="Avocado Type")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

#8:
average_sales = (
    california_avocados
    .groupby(["geography", "type"], as_index=False)[
        ["small_hass_volume", "large_hass_volume", "extra_large_hass_volume"]
    ]
    .mean()
)
size_sales = average_sales.melt(
    id_vars=["geography", "type"],
    value_vars=[
        "small_hass_volume",
        "large_hass_volume",
        "extra_large_hass_volume",
    ],
    var_name="size",
    value_name="average_volume"
)
size_sales["size"] = size_sales["size"].replace(
    {
        "small_hass_volume": "Small",
        "large_hass_volume": "Large",
        "extra_large_hass_volume": "Xlarge",
    }
)
size_sales["proportion"] = (
    size_sales["average_volume"]
    / size_sales.groupby(["geography", "type"])["average_volume"].transform("sum")
)
region_order = ["Los Angeles", "Sacramento", "San Diego", "San Francisco"]
size_order = ["Small", "Large", "Xlarge"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 7), sharey=True)

colors = {
    "Small": "#C46B25",
    "Large": "#5A9B7A",
    "Xlarge": "#7772B2",
}

for ax, avocado_type in zip(axes, ["conventional", "organic"]):
    plot_data = size_sales[size_sales["type"] == avocado_type]

    bottom = pd.Series(0, index=region_order, dtype=float)

    for size in size_order:
        values = (
            plot_data[plot_data["size"] == size]
            .set_index("geography")
            .reindex(region_order)["proportion"]
        )

        ax.bar(
            region_order,
            values,
            bottom=bottom,
            label=size,
            color=colors[size]
        )

        bottom = bottom + values

    ax.set_title(avocado_type)
    ax.set_xlabel("Region of California")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)

axes[0].set_ylabel("Proportion")
axes[0].set_yticks([0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00])
axes[0].set_yticklabels(["0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"])

fig.suptitle("Proportion of Average Hass Avocado Sales by Size", fontsize=16)
axes[1].legend(title="Size", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5), loc="center left")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
#9:
zillow = pd.read_csv("zillow_zhvi_metro.csv")
print(
    zillow.loc[
        zillow["StateName"] == "CA",
        "RegionName"
    ].to_string(index=False)
)
zillow_metros = [
    "Los Angeles, CA",
    "San Diego, CA",
    "Sacramento, CA",
    "San Francisco, CA",
]

zillow_ca = zillow[
    zillow["RegionName"].isin(zillow_metros)
].copy()

zillow_ca["geography"] = zillow_ca["RegionName"].str.replace(
    ", CA",
    "",
    regex=False
)

date_columns = [
    column for column in zillow_ca.columns
    if column[:4].isdigit() 
]

housing_long = zillow_ca.melt(
    id_vars="RegionName",
    value_vars=date_columns,
    var_name="date",
    value_name="home_value"
)

housing_long["date"] = pd.to_datetime(housing_long["date"])
housing_long["month"] = housing_long["date"].dt.to_period("M")
housing_long["geography"] = housing_long["RegionName"].str.replace(
    ", CA",
    "",
    regex=False
)

housing_long = housing_long[
    ["month", "geography", "home_value"]
]
california_avocados["month"] = california_avocados["date"].dt.to_period("M")

monthly_avocados = (
    california_avocados
    .groupby(["month", "geography"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        average_avocado_price=("average_price", "mean"),
        total_avocado_sales=("total_volume", "sum")
    )
)

avocado_housing = monthly_avocados.merge(
    housing_long,
    on=["month", "geography"],
    how="inner"
)

print(avocado_housing.head())
print(
    avocado_housing[
        ["home_value", "average_avocado_price", "total_avocado_sales"]
    ].corr().round(2)
)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

sns.scatterplot(
    data=avocado_housing,
    x="home_value",
    y="average_avocado_price",
    hue="geography",
    alpha=0.7
)

plt.title("Home Values vs. Average Avocado Prices in California Metro Areas")
plt.xlabel("Typical Home Value (ZHVI, $)")
plt.ylabel("Average Avocado Price ($)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
